D: Superman gives up his powers to be with Lois just as three Kryptonian outlaws arrive and make the President kneel.
P: Serve the minute steak when Clark comes back for his favourite seat.
S: Hot dogs with mustard and onion, from Clark's run to Niagara.
Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft and golden. Grill the franks, turning, until blistered. Toast the rolls, tuck in the franks and top with onions, mustard and sauce.
Crisp fries under melted cheese. Three outlaws from Krypton land.
Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Pile into an ovenproof dish, scatter over the three cheeses and grill until bubbling. Top with spring onions and serve with sour cream.
M: Meatloaf with gravy and mash. Rocky calls Annie's special garbage.

Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mince, onion, egg, Worcestershire and salt and shape into a loaf in a tin. Mix the tomato sauce and sugar, spread over the top and bake at 180C. Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and the rest of the milk. Simmer the stock with the pan juices and thicken with the cornflour. Slice thick and serve with mash and gravy.
Keep it on the flame minute steak
Minute steak with onion rings and fries. Keep it on the flame, Rock.

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Whisk the flour and soda water into a batter, dip the onion rings and fry at 180C until golden. Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan with the oil, 1 minute a side, adding the butter at the end. Serve with the rings and fries.
2 tbsp vegetable oil, plus 1l for frying@Pantry
2 large onions, cut in thick rings@Produce
W: Kneel before Zod chocolate cream pie
Chocolate cream pie in a biscuit crust. Zod makes the President kneel.

Crush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a 22cm pie dish, then chill. Whisk the milk, sugar, cornflour and yolks in a pan over medium heat until thick. Stir in the chocolate until smooth, pour into the base and chill until set. Whip the cream and pile it on top.
K: Fresh squeezed orange juice, cold. Clark forgot Lois's orange juice.
Squeeze the oranges. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and add a mint sprig.
